weekly.approved_text: Tuesday introduces threshold intervals; Friday stays easy alongside Sunday’s long run. Strength uses the selected standard doses and prescribed repetitions in reserve.
Tuesday lengthens the threshold repetitions while Friday remains easy. Strength stays at standard doses, with the written effort margins retained.
Tuesday extends the threshold repetitions. Friday combines easy running with relaxed strides; strength remains standard, with controlled execution throughout.
Tuesday and Friday reduce running workload for consolidation. Strength reduces the specified upper-body sets, while RDL work retains its prescribed dose without a planned load increase.
Tuesday builds to longer threshold repetitions; Friday supports the week with easy running and relaxed strides. Standard strength doses resume with the prescribed effort margins.
Tuesday becomes the main 10K-paced session. Friday adds shorter 5K-paced support work; strength continues at its selected standard doses and effort margins.
Tuesday uses longer 10K-paced repetitions, while Friday lengthens its short-5K repetitions. This remains a standard strength week, with the written doses and recovery periods retained.
Tuesday carries the peak 10K-specific work; Friday is deliberately lighter. RDL and lunge work use the selected 3-RIR doses, with no planned lower-body load increase.
Tuesday retains 10K-specific work and Friday remains brief. Strength volume reduces, including the selected RDL reduction and omission of lunges, as the programme reduces fatigue.

Tuesday’s short 10K-paced repetitions and Friday’s easy running with relaxed strides lead into Sunday’s measured test. Strength tapers; Thursday contains only the selected upper-body work at at least 3 RIR.

freshness_message: Your 5K result must be no more than 56 local calendar days old when you start this workout. If you have a newer qualifying result, update your input and review the targets. Otherwise, this workout remains unavailable. This programme does not add a 5K test. Threshold workouts also support the separately selected manual-threshold option. A workout already started keeps its accepted targets.
scope: Additive approved coaching explanations only. Existing session graphs, exercise identities, doses, order, work/recovery steps, targets and start/freeze rules remain unchanged. This document does not claim the copy is installed in a client or published programme.
